description: How the roles of the property marketplace relate to each other: who mandates and markets, who inquires and views, how money changes hands at closing, and which data and financing loops connect the ecosystem.

relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Mandating agencies, licensing software, and offering financing

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Listing, searching, inquiring, and viewing day to day

relationTypes.name: Financial
relationTypes.description: Purchase prices, rents, and commissions settled at closing

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Pricing advice, market intelligence, and intent signals

relations.name: Mandates agency to sell or let
relations.description: Engages a brokerage under a sales or letting mandate to price, market, and negotiate the property on the owner's behalf.

relations.name: Markets listings to seekers
relations.description: Publishes and promotes mandated listings on the marketplace so high-intent buyers and tenants discover them in search and alerts.

relations.name: Sends inquiries and viewing requests
relations.description: Contacts agencies through listing pages to ask questions, request viewings, and progress toward an offer.

relations.name: Contacts private owners directly
relations.description: Reaches individual sellers and landlords on privately listed homes to arrange viewings and negotiate without an intermediary.

relations.name: Pays purchase price or rent
relations.description: Pays the agreed purchase price or recurring rent to the owner once a marketplace-sourced match closes, typically settled off-platform at notary or lease signing.

relations.name: Pays commission on closed deals
relations.description: Pays the agreed brokerage commission or letting fee when the mandated property is sold or rented.

relations.name: Advises pricing with market data
relations.description: Advises owners on asking price and expected time on market using comparable listings and demand data from the marketplace.

relations.name: Licenses listing-management software
relations.description: Licenses broker software from integration partners to manage listings, contacts, and transactions in one back office.

relations.name: Syndicates listings into the marketplace
relations.description: Pushes listings created in broker software to the marketplace via feed integrations so agencies publish once and appear everywhere.

relations.name: Offers mortgage financing to buyers
relations.description: Presents financing offers and affordability checks to high-intent buyers at the moment they evaluate a specific home.

relations.name: Signals purchase intent and affordability
relations.description: Generates high-intent lead and affordability signals through searches, saved homes, and financing requests that lenders use to qualify prospects.

relations.name: Feeds transaction and pricing signals
relations.description: Contributes listing, price-change, and transaction activity that powers the market intelligence lenders and data partners buy.
